title: Pag-IBIG opens 2nd National Housing Expo, offers loans of up to P10 million
summary: The Pag-IBIG Fund on Monday opened the 2nd National Housing Expo 2026 at the SMX Convention Center in Pasay City, to help more Filipino families acquire quality and affordable homes.
